verdict.rationale: The evidence covers downloading prebuilt model checkpoints and lists platform apps (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). It never documents installing the Edge0 software itself from prebuilt binaries, release artifacts, or a package manager. The `.venv/bin/python scripts/...` usage points to a source or repo checkout, and the 'single download is a ready-to-run model' line concerns model weights, not the software install, so it is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source
